## Comparison

| Feature | Construction Management Diploma | Construction Management Bachelor of Technology |
|---|---|---|
| Credential | Diploma | Bachelor of Technology / bachelor’s degree |
| Format | Part-time, blended | Full-time or part-time, in person |
| Location | Burnaby Campus / online | Burnaby |
| Focus | Detailed curriculum could not be verified from the available Asteris data | Degree-completion program focused on construction-project management, technical skills, and interpersonal skills |
| Curriculum information | Not available in the retrieved program record | Includes construction controls, organization management, stakeholder engagement, management electives, liberal studies, and professional standards |
| Professional project | Not verified | Students complete **CMGT 8700 — Industry Based Project Proposal**, then choose one final project: **CMGT 8800 — Industry Based Project** or **CMGT 8810 — Industry Based Project** |

The Bachelor of Technology also requires at least **12 Liberal Studies credits** and at least **4 credits from the approved management-elective pool**. Its admission structure includes several alternative entry pathways, including a construction-related post-secondary credential with a minimum **67% GPA** and at least **one year of construction-industry experience**.

The diploma is the shorter credential and is offered in a flexible part-time/blended format. The Bachelor of Technology is a higher-level degree-completion pathway with broader management, stakeholder, liberal-studies, and professional-project requirements. I could not verify the diploma’s detailed curriculum or admission requirements from the available Asteris data.
